name: what_can_you_do
description: Read FRED's own list of skills as plain text, straight from the installed skill folders: with no topic, the skill groups; with a group name, that group's skills; with a skill name, its full details; with any other words, the skills that mention them.

topic.description: empty = list the groups; a group or skill name = details; other words = search the skills

examples: tell me about your memory skills
how does the recall skill work
not_for: using a skill (just ask for the thing itself)
questions about the project's history or code (use read_own_docs)
